laws.rule: National park entry (general rate, which applies to foreign visitors), daily pass from 1 June 2026: Iguazú ARS 60,000. Children 0 to 6 free. Flexipass 3- and 7-day passes are also sold. (No RBA rate for ARS; at the Banco Central de la República Argentina rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 1,078.2486 ARS: ARS 60,000 ≈ A$55.65)

laws.rule: Iguazú entry includes the Sendero Verde, the ecological train and the Upper, Lower and Garganta del Diablo circuits; pay in cash or by Visa or Mastercard.

culture-cycles.note: The official 2026 national holidays dataset of the Ministry of the Interior lists no additional provincial holiday for Misiones Province. National public holidays are on Argentina's record. Recurring provincial patron or foundation days are not in that dataset, so this record does not claim a complete provincial calendar. The 2027 official dataset had not been published when this was checked.
